highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp 4.159.0 update hardens glyph rendering and handles specific Vulkan allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

bullets.lead: Handle changing glyph paths and mask layouts
bullets.detail: Mask-filtered glyph rendering uses the reloaded glyph rather than stale initial state when successive loads disagree about paths, formats or bounds. Incompatible masks are cleared instead of overflowing sub-byte rows, and clipped embossed masks use full plane strides for correct copying.

bullets.lead: Avoid driver failures after Vulkan allocation errors
bullets.detail: On Imagination drivers, Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after descriptor-set allocation reports host or device out-of-memory, because destroying those pools can trigger a driver failure. Graphite also stops allocating through the abandoned handle. The workaround applies only to that vendor and those errors.
